author: TeIq
content: Backend half of #214. Plan: (1) migration #46 adds pinned_admin column + monotone trigger; (2) extend maybe_grant_first_user_admin to set pinned_admin=TRUE atomically; (3) gate complete_login against moderator allow-list except when moderators table empty (bootstrap carve-out); (4) new ApiError::NotAllowed variant + AuthError::NotAllowed mapping to /login?error=unauthorized redirect; (5) new admin module + endpoints at /api/admin/moderators (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE) admin-only with audit-log entries; (6) integration test in tests/moderator_acl.rs covering reject-non-allowlist, first-user-pinned, can't-delete-pinned, can't-demote-last-admin, trigger-blocks-direct-update.
